images.note: IRAS4B. C18O (2-1) integrated-intensity contours (integrated over +/-3 km/s about v_LSR=+6.7 km/s) drawn over the N2H+ (1-0) integrated-intensity colour background; the emission is elongated along the N-S outflow. The small inset in this panel is the compact CH3OH (5_1-4_2) emission, staged as a separate record. Observed with the IRAM Plateau de Bure Interferometer (A and C configurations) between November 2010 and November 2011 (Sect. 2); the paper gives only this survey span, not per-source dates, so epoch is the span.
